subject: Zenith Health — production 5xx/429 bursts and retry amplification
messages:
From: Robin Chang <robin.chang@zenithhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-18T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: High 5xx/429 spikes impacting Recommendations API (prod)

Marissa,

Sorry to ping early — we started seeing sharp 5xx and 429 spikes on our Recommendations endpoint around 07:45 PDT and it's affecting live traffic for a subset of users. Latency jumps to 3-5s, and our clients are retrying aggressively which looks like it's amplifying the surge. We have a support window with Commerce at 09:00 and need a mitigation plan ASAP.

Attached is a 30s tail of error lines and a screenshot of our dashboard. Example: several 5xx: GPU_OOM or TIMEOUT on Redwood's endpoint.

What we need: quick triage, temporary fallback option (smaller model or hosted pool route), and confirmation on whether this is an autoscaler lag vs full capacity depletion. Also want to preserve logs for SOC/audit.

Thanks — Robin
Product Ops, Zenith Health

Attachments: zenith_5xx_tail.txt (text), dashboard_snapshot.png (image)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Subject: Fwd: High 5xx/429 spikes impacting Recommendations API (prod)

Forwarding Zenith ops report — they see 5xx/429 bursts starting ~07:45 PDT, retry amplification suspected.

Rishi/Eng: can you take point on triage? Monica/CS: please keep the customer apprised with an ETA.

Priority asks:
- Confirm whether this is Dedicated pool GPU exhaustion + autoscale lag or a model-level OOM.
- If autoscaler lag, can we route traffic to hosted fallbacks and deploy a config to deny-list the heavy prefix that spiked?
- Short-term: reduce concurrency or enforcement of per-api-key backoff to stop retries.

I attached their tail and a Kibana link they sent.

Marissa
